name: thebluesland-web-css
description: US-013 AC1 (spec 12.2 'Styling: Tailwind CSS 4 plus CSS custom properties'): production Tailwind CSS build chain for src/TheBluesland.Web. This is the build tool only - no Razor markup uses Tailwind utility classes yet, so today's output is Tailwind's base reset. Wiring the compiled stylesheet into App.razor and adopting utility classes across Components/ is separate, later design work.
